description: FREE MARKETPLACE FILTERED DISCOVERY ONLY. Search active public marketplace capabilities when one or more filters are known: text, category, provider, delivery type, or price. Metadata is free; purchased execution and deliverables are not. Do NOT use for unfiltered browsing; use catalog.list. Do NOT use for CrossingKey digital/service offers; use offers.list. For one exact capabilityId use capability.get.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return; 1-100, defaults to 25.

maxPrice.description: Optional inclusive maximum USDC price in atomic units.

minPrice.description: Optional inclusive minimum USDC price in atomic units.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive search text across capability name, description, and category; maximum 160 characters.
